title: Espaces stratifiés et voisinages côniques (ou : déploiement des espaces stratifiés) : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting. Grothendieck is formalising the 'déploiement' (unfolding) of a stratified space as an internal category Σ in Top. Σ(0) is the space of objects: the disjoint union of the unfolded strata. Σ(1) is the space of arrows. There are two structure maps from arrows to objects, s (source) and b (but = target), and δ: Σ(0)→Σ(1) is the identity section. The previous page put a preorder on I = π0(Σ(0)), using fibrancy of b and a π0-surjectivity lemma for pullbacks of fibrations. It then built the canonical functor φ: Σ → I to the discrete topological category of this preordered set. This splits the spaces as Σ(0) = ⊔ Σ_i and Σ(1) = ⊔_{i≤j} Σ_ij, compatibly with s and b.

First line of this page. φ has the obvious universal property: it is the reflection of the topological category Σ into preordered sets. Every continuous functor from Σ to a preordered set factors uniquely through Σ → π0-preorder.

New hypotheses.
(a) b: Σ(1)→Σ(0) is a proper immersion. Since b∘δ = id and b is locally injective, δ is an open and closed embedding. Openness: near δ(x) take U on which b is injective; then U ∩ b^{-1}(δ^{-1}(U)) ⊂ δ(Σ(0)). Closedness follows from properness/separation. Hence Σ(1) = δ(Σ(0)) ⊔ Σ*(1), where Σ*(1) is the space of non-identity arrows.
(b) b restricted to Σ*(1) is an immersion with rare (nowhere dense) image.
(c) Each connected component of Σ(0) is finite-dimensional.

Claim. Σ*_ii := Σ_ii ∩ Σ*(1) is empty. The argument is by dimension:
- Σ*_ii is fibred over Σ_i (via the fibrant structure map), so if it is non-empty, dim Σ*_ii ≥ dim Σ_i.
- But b: Σ*_ii → Σ_i is an immersion with rare image, so dim Σ*_ii < dim Σ_i.

Conclusion: Σ_i ≅ Σ_ii. Every arrow between two objects in the same connected component is an identity. The category has no non-identity endo-arrows within a component; it is 'direct' along components.

Next page. Adding (d), no non-identity invertible arrows, makes I an honest ordered set and the functor Σ→I strictly increasing on non-identity arrows. This is then used to recover the combinatorial data (Σ_i, Σ_ij, s_ij, t_ij) of the déploiement of a locally equisingular stratification.

Geometric meaning. Σ_ij (i<j) is the link-bundle / boundary face: it fibres over the unfolded stratum Σ_i and is properly immersed as a boundary piece (hence nowhere dense) into the unfolded stratum Σ_j. The page shows that these geometric axioms force the internal category to be posetal over its component poset.
errors: The dimension step is only heuristic in general topology. 'Fibred over Σ_i ⇒ dim ≥ dim Σ_i' needs surjectivity (Σ_i connected, path-lifting, local path-connectedness) and some local triviality or dimension theory for fibrations. 'Image rare ⇒ strictly smaller dimension' holds for (locally equidimensional) topological manifolds or manifolds with corners, but not for arbitrary finite-dimensional spaces. In the intended setting (unfolded strata are manifolds with boundary/corners) the argument is fine.

The 'fibred' structure comes from the source map s, while the immersion comes from the target b. The comparison of dimensions is between the same space Σ*_ii and Σ_i via two different maps. This is legitimate, but it is not made explicit.
Openness of δ needs only local injectivity of b; properness is used only for closedness/separation. The text bundles both under '⇒'. This is a minor point.

ideas.what: Reflection of a topological (internal) category into preordered sets via π0 of objects, with the preorder generated by arrows
ideas.modern_name: posetal/π0 reflection; stratification poset of an exit-path-type category
ideas.usually_credited_to: folklore; in stratified homotopy theory, Lurie (Higher Algebra App. A), Ayala–Francis–Tanaka

ideas.what: Encoding the déploiement (unfolding) of a stratified space as an internal category in Top: objects are unfolded strata, arrows are link-bundle boundary faces, source is a fibration, target is a proper immersion with rare image
ideas.modern_name: unzipping/resolution of conically smooth stratified spaces; Thom–Mather abstract stratified sets; Verona's unfolding; system of link bundles
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme §5 sketches déploiement of tame stratified spaces, but not this internal-category formalism

ideas.what: Dimension argument: the geometric axioms (proper immersion, rare image, finite dimension) force all endo-arrows within a component to be identities, so the category is direct/posetal over its components
ideas.modern_name: directness (Reedy-direct / EI with trivial endomorphisms) of the stratification category

missed.claim: Grothendieck models the unfolding of a stratified space as an internal category in Top. Its axioms are: source is a fibration; target is a proper immersion that is the identity section plus a part with nowhere-dense image; components are finite-dimensional. He derives from these that the category is posetal over its stratification poset. This anticipates the modern view of stratified spaces as categories (exit-path ∞-categories; AFT's unzipping, where link bundles are maps to lower strata and boundary inclusions into higher ones), but phrased as a strict topological category of resolved strata rather than paths.
missed.quote: a) Σ(1) --b--> Σ(0) est une immersion propre (⇒ δ : Σ(0) → Σ(1) est une immersion ouverte et fermée ...) b) Σ*(1) → Σ(0) est une immersion à images rares ... Σ_i ≃ Σ_ii
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: This gives a strict, point-set 'category of resolved strata' presentation of conically smooth / Thom–Mather stratified spaces. It could be compared with AFT's unzip functor and with Lurie's exit-path categories, giving an intrinsic categorical characterisation of which topological categories arise as unfoldings.

deep.surprise_reason: The internal-category formalisation of déploiement is a genuine, little-known Grothendieck approach. However, the lemma on this page (no non-identity endo-arrows within a component, by a dimension count) is routine. The broader ideas (unfolding, link bundles, the stratification poset) are well developed in the later literature.
transcription_corrections: Line 2: 'de la catégorie strat.-logiques [?] Σ' should read roughly 'de la catégorie topologique Σ' (morphisms of the topological category Σ into a preordered set).
Condition b): 'immersion à images localement [?] rares' — the image reads 'à images rares' (with 'rares' underlined), glossed 'i.e. : intérieurs vides ...'.
Condition c): 'Toute composante' is partly struck and rewritten; the sense is 'Toute composante connexe de Σ(0) est de dimension finie'.
The final sentence reads 'toute flèche entre deux éléments de Σ(0) qui sont dans une même composante connexe est une identité', with 'objets' struck and replaced by 'éléments'.
